core_obligations: Set up the comparison square for L_{B/A}
Prove injectivity via associated primes of omega_{V/X}
Conclude tau = c(1) and the sheaf equality
difficulty_reason: The different sheaf agrees with the Dedekind different: the commutative square (L_{B/A} -> L -> Hom_K(L,K) over omega) with the factorization of the base-change map through Gamma(V, omega_{V/X}) injects by the associated-primes lemma, tau_{V/X} maps to Trace_{L/K} by definition, giving tau = c(1) iff 1 in L_{B/A} and the equality of ideal sheaves. Retained author proof at lines 3283-3321.
